critical_code_review_comments: MemberCard.jsx uses window.location.origin for QR verify URL — good; QR renders via api.qrserver.com as designed.

ParticipantsMatrix.jsx canAct=isSelf is clean; MPCA gets no action buttons even though canManage is still passed in — the prop is now effectively unused for row-level acceptance but still used for Resync/NEFT/Reminders/CSV export (which is correct).
tournaments.py: role gate (`x_role_id in _ACCEPTANCE_ROLES`) runs BEFORE tournament lookup — good defensive ordering. Also enforces persona-body match after role gate. Both layers work.

tournament_participations.py PATCH: scope.body_code comparison uses `!=` which correctly blocks any non-matching body incl. MPCA. If body_code header is absent (unauth request), scope.body_code is None and the check is bypassed — but the rest of the app already sets headers via axios interceptor, so risk is low. Consider adding a hard requirement on X-Body-Code for defense-in-depth.
